info.cls_ename: Professional Master's Program of Graduate Institute of Financial and Economic Law

description.describe_ch: 這個科目的教學目的在從經濟學的角度看法律的原則，以經濟模型分析法律原則，根據效率判準提供對法律的理解、制訂或修改法律的建議。內容涵蓋英美法體系下民法的財產權、契約及侵權。
description.describe_eh: This course provides economic theories to predict the effects of legal rules on human behavior. In addition, it provides useful normative standards, such as efficiency and equity, for evaluating law and public policy. This course covers property, contract, tort and criminal law.

targets.describe_ch: 能說明法律經濟學的基本原理並說明法律的合理性與經濟邏輯。
targets.describe_en: Describe the principles of economic analysis of law; explain the reason and economic logic of law.

targets.describe_ch: 能瞭解並說明法律的經濟分析對法律制訂與經濟社會的重要性及影響。
targets.describe_en: Understand and explain the importance and impacts of economic analysis to law making, society and economy.

targets.describe_ch: 能運用相關理論，解釋既存的法律，並歸納出適當結論及對法律的制訂或修改提出建言。
targets.describe_en: Be able to use related theories to explain the existing law, draw appropriate conclusions and suggestions to law making.
